_comment: Liquid profiles for the Fluigent flow units. Edit this file by hand; admet reads
it at startup and ships it as part of the package.
unit         which flow unit the profile is for: 'L' or 'M'. A channel is only
offered profiles matching the unit it carries.
calibration  Fluigent sensor calibration table (see SENSOR_CALIBRATIONS).
scale        proportional term of the sensor custom scale, i.e. the correction
factor: true_flow = scale * sensor_reading. Derive it gravimetrically
(dispense a target volume, weigh it, divide by the target).
offset       square term of the custom scale, 0 unless characterised.
quadratic    cubic term of the custom scale, 0 unless characterised.
density      g/mL, used to turn a weighed mass into a volume during calibration.
